title: Deterministic worker-result acceptance gate
goal: Accept a worker result only when dispatch evidence, worker scope evidence and independent verifier evidence all bind to the same mission/job.
laws: Worker ok=true is never sufficient by itself.
Dispatch ticket, worker result and independent verification must bind the same mission/job.
Verification verdict must be PASS and every declared check true.
Acceptance grants no new execution authority.
Malformed or mismatched evidence fails closed.
